eligibility: unseen independent event cluster, not used in task/prompt/policy/Gold development
natural DAG and legal action space; no added model nodes to force a difference
independently confirmed terminal reference and frozen scoring method/scope
full common input/source/cache/contract versions and metering identity
real candidates and capability uncertainty supported; no invented quality cells
forbidden_development_events: any other event found in development registry; list is non-exhaustive
arm_order: Repeat 1: four AB and four BA, assigned by SHA256(seed + sealed event ID); repeat 2 flips order

primary_endpoint.name: median event-paired utility difference
primary_endpoint.formula: u = S * Q_terminal - 0.10 * tokens / B_tokens - 0.10 * min(L / D, 2)
primary_endpoint.S: 1 iff legal complete terminal delivery meets frozen terminal quality threshold and deadline, else 0
primary_endpoint.quality_threshold_applies_to: independent outcome assessment; does not replace/remove any predictor-side hard quality gate
primary_endpoint.undefined_quality: never impute a Q value; when S=0, the successful-delivery utility term is absent, not evidence Q=0
primary_endpoint.unknown_tokens_or_elapsed: utility unidentified; no primary positive/equivalence verdict
primary_endpoint.cost_definition: actual total tokens for primary; actual bills and per-currency estimates reported separately
primary_endpoint.event_delta: mean of the two V5-minus-RL paired utility differences within event

statistical_analysis.primary: one-sided exact sign test of event_delta > 0.01, alpha=0.05; exact ties at 0.01 omitted and reported
statistical_analysis.cluster_unit: 8 events, not 16 pairs or scoring atoms
statistical_analysis.interval: distribution-free at-least-95% median sign/order-statistic confidence interval; for n=8, [min,max] is conservative (~99.21875% under continuous iid sampling)
guardrails: mean terminal Q among both-valid paired observations V5-RL >= -0.02; descriptive guard, NOT a noninferiority proof
statistical_analysis.secondary: quality, coverage, evidence, schema, full contract, abstention, token use, per-currency fees, local planning and end-to-end time; all cases retained
statistical_analysis.subgroups: only predeclared fault/cache categories; descriptive with all group sizes; no post-hoc rule fitting

result_decisions.positive_signal: median event_delta >0.01, sign-test p<=0.05, all guardrails; independent replication still required
result_decisions.conditional_signal: predeclared states show a pattern without overall confirmation; conditional hypothesis only, no tuned policy
result_decisions.bounded_near_equivalence: valid median interval entirely inside [-0.01,0.01]; narrow contribution, no added complexity
result_decisions.inconclusive: no confirmation and interval not inside margin; cannot claim equivalence or superiority; no automatic extension
result_decisions.negative: V5 worse or safety/quality degradation; preserve and narrow claims

stop_conditions: before sending if task/Gold/protocol/price/input identity/authorization gate fails
no feasible action or same selected action: retain the event, do not replace it for favorable data
global request/token/time/fee threshold; unknown usage or remote completion; identity drift; unexpected credentials/network path
necessary Gold/scorer defect after outputs: preserve, stop, no answer-dependent exclusion or replacement
at completion of the single bounded batch: stop regardless of results
missing_execution_fields: 8 event IDs and independent cluster split/custody evidence
actual DAGs, required terminal items, Gold and scoring signatures
per-task common budgets, deadlines and original quality constraints
complete common initial states, cache versions and arm-specific dispatch bodies
current prices, certified or explicitly accepted input upper bound and fee safety
executable counted binding and specific paid authorization
budget_status: historical-rate conditional estimate only; not current prices, actual bill or cash hard upper

conditional_budget.note: Caps are design ceilings, not a dispatch authorization. Per-task feasibility is still HOLD. Prefix above 16 calls or recovery above 3 calls/arm is ineligible, not silently appended.
